title: 红桥 Hong Qiao
subtitle: a bridge · outside the walls · confidence A, assumed

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 1 plain block (walls, houses, halls). Its shape follows the source named under Where. The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Rainbow Bridge, where the road from 海淀 crosses the 红桥河

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a bridge outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: in use; seen 6 Oct 1860 (S240 pp.228-229: 'a handsome bridge with richly-carved parapet walls')

facts.label: Where
facts.value: C: crossing of my road line (today's 颐和园路 north of 海淀) and the 红桥河 line (today's 万泉河) at the PKU west gate

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 1792 road list starts 直抵紅橋 (S1230 j79). Wolseley: about half a mile north of the town. d'Hérisson p.301: a 'pont monumental' over a canal 200 m before the palace: the same or another bridge (Q). Malone p.55: guards 'as far as the Hung Chiao, about half way to the Ch'ang Ch'un Yuan': does not fit (Q). Also: S1008 '蔚秀园东北，颐和园路上'; placed at today's bend of 颐和园路 (osm ways 146747108 / 25686353), C (Rainbow (Red) Bridge on the approach road), 20 m from the point used.
